production_model_policy: No changes. This experiment is isolated from production predictors and notifications.

data_contract.odds: BoatraceCSV data/previews/od3 captured before the deadline
data_contract.settlement: Official result archive cross-checked against BoatraceCSV payouts

checkpoints.early_stop: Stop if a pre-scheduled day-block bootstrap 95% upper bound is below 100% ROI.
checkpoints.pass: At final date, ROI must exceed 100% and the day-block bootstrap 95% lower bound must also exceed 100%.
checkpoints.next_stage: A pass creates a second untouched validation year; it does not authorize real-money betting.

challenger_policy.rule: Every improvement gets a new version and starts scoring only after its registration date.
challenger_policy.promotion: Promote only after an untouched comparison window; never rewrite Champion v1 history.
